mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the chest and lower body was most worthwhile: the diaphragm and the separate routes crossing between regions made the overall arrangement clearer.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the digestive tract and urinary organs into named slots was straightforward but felt more like placement than a meaningful decision.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the repaired skin segment to remain a small patch with its scar in the same place, rather than represent the whole covering.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though some slot fittings were essentially following explicit labels rather than figuring out a connection.

continue.text: I probably would not continue immediately. Seeing the body assembled was a satisfying ending, but many of this chapter's choices were predictable fittings.
